address: 36 Quanzhoucuo, Tamsui District, New Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Opened in 2012, this Zen-inspired space at a remove from the city is an oasis. Wood details and pops of red add warmth to the bare concrete room overlooking a manicured garden. The husband-and-wife team, both avid gardeners and tea lovers, wanted to deliver creative, refined Chinese cooking in omakase style. Velvety and creamy, their chicken soup is thickened with brown rice gruel and exudes the deep aroma of scallops. Vegan menu available by arrangement.
